summary.headline: Defensive risk migrated into Wednesday; 7650 is now the active weekly decision level
key_points: Wednesday shifted from a supportive baseline to defensive flow, including two 7700 synthetic-short-like packages.
Thursday moved the other way: repeated 7675/7700 put selling and 7650/7675 put-credit-like spreads add risk acceptance.
Friday remains defensive through 7640 and 7580 put demand, but raw call selling is heavily distorted by a $14.8M deep-ITM 7025C cluster.
The former 7675-7700 pivot is now overhead; 7665-7675 is the first reclaim zone and 7700 is the major cross-expiry regime boundary.
7650 was pierced intraday and reclaimed in the visible tape; acceptance below it activates 7640, then 7580-7575.
summary.daily_note: Stateful update versus the Friday 2026-08-21 baseline. The main bearish warning partially triggered because protection rolled forward into Wednesday expiry, while Thursday simultaneously became more supportive.

leave_one_out.comment: Structure-level removal of the deep-ITM 7025C cluster flips total call premium from -$10.568M net sold to +$4.232M net bought. The robust defensive signal is concentrated in near-spot put demand and Wednesday synthetic-short-like flow.

levels.label: MAJOR CROSS-EXPIRY REGIME BOUNDARY
levels.interpretation: Wednesday synthetic-short-like packages now oppose earlier supportive inventory, while Thursday put-selling and Friday mixed flow keep 7700 as a conflict boundary rather than a simple cap.

levels.label: OVERHEAD RECLAIM / BATTLE ZONE
levels.interpretation: The former weekly pivot has moved overhead after spot traded down to 7643.7. Reclaim of 7665-7675 is the first step toward repairing the weekly structure.

levels.label: ACTIVE DECISION LEVEL
levels.interpretation: 7650 was pierced intraday and recovered by the end of the visible tape. Fresh Tuesday/Wednesday put demand and Thursday put-credit-like structures make this the active weekly decision level.

notes: Visible tape low was 7643.7; latest visible spot was 7653.7.

levels.label: NEW ACTIVE DOWNSIDE PROTECTION
levels.interpretation: Friday 7640P demand is large enough to upgrade 7640 from a transit level to an active protection zone.

levels.label: MAJOR TAIL HEDGE
levels.interpretation: Fresh Friday buying reinforces the 7575-7580 tail zone that was already important in the baseline.

levels.label: UPPER DECISION / CONFLICT
levels.interpretation: Thursday call demand at 7725-7735 conflicts with late-week call supply, so this is an upper decision zone rather than a clean target.

beneficiaries: short-vol inventory if spot remains trapped
monetization_zones.description: This is now the noisy middle where bought movement, put risk acceptance, and defensive protection overlap.
monetization_zones.caveat: Acceptance outside the band is more informative than raw premium inside it.

monetization_zones.description: Closest downside protection and butterfly geometry overlap here.
monetization_zones.caveat: A protection zone is not guaranteed support if spot accepts below it.

monetization_zones.description: Fresh put buying reinforces the major lower-tail hedge zone.
monetization_zones.caveat: This is a protection concentration, not a deterministic downside target.

summary.headline: Tuesday shifted from supportive range to defensive/mixed long-vol around 7650

levels.label: TUE 7650 VOL / DECISION CENTER
levels.interpretation: Near-spot flow flipped from baseline put-selling to net put buying; 7650 sits at the center of the bought-movement geometry.

levels.label: TUE RECLAIM BATTLE
levels.interpretation: Large 7665C buying conflicts with call sales and put demand around 7650-7675.

levels.label: TUE LOWER STRANGLE WING
levels.interpretation: Bought 7630P is the lower wing of the probable 7630P/7670C long-strangle-like package.

structures.interpretation: Matched-size 7630P and 7670C buying around spot 7652 suggests movement was bought around a 7650 center; spread flag means linkage is probable, not proven.

monetization_zones.description: Movement is bought around a roughly 7650 center.
monetization_zones.caveat: Spread flag means hidden legs may exist.

summary.headline: Wednesday is the main deterioration: supportive baseline inverted by 7700 synthetic-short-like flow and net put buying

levels.label: WED 7700 SYNTHETIC-SHORT BOUNDARY
levels.interpretation: Two separate equal-size sell-7700C/buy-7700P packages invert the supportive baseline geometry.

levels.label: WED 7675 PUT DEMAND
levels.interpretation: Net put buying around 7675 confirms that protection has migrated into Wednesday expiry.

levels.label: WED 7650 LOWER DECISION
levels.interpretation: Fresh put buying makes 7650 the first lower decision level if spot cannot hold the reclaim.

structures.interpretation: Sell 7700C plus buy 7700P in equal size is synthetic-short-like. It directly opposes Friday baseline supportive inventory around 7700-7710.
A second equal-size sell-call/buy-put package at 7700 reinforces the forward migration of defensive risk into Wednesday expiry.

summary.headline: Thursday improved versus baseline: 7675-7700 put risk acceptance offsets prior defensive geometry

levels.label: THU 7675-7700 RISK ACCEPTANCE
levels.interpretation: Repeated block put sales at 7675/7700 and later put-credit-like spreads soften the previously defensive Thursday baseline.

levels.label: THU 7650 LIMITED DOWNSIDE
levels.interpretation: 7650P purchases paired with 7675P sales limit downside while accepting risk above the lower leg.

levels.label: THU UPSIDE CALL DEMAND
levels.interpretation: Large spread-flagged call buying at 7725/7735 adds upside participation, but hidden legs may exist below the $50k tape filter.

structures.interpretation: Repeated buy-7650P / sell-7675P equal-size spreads accept downside risk above 7650 while limiting the tail below; this offsets part of the defensive weekly migration.
Repeated block put sales at 7675 and 7700 show downside risk acceptance in Thursday expiry, though opening/closing is unknown.

beneficiaries: put-credit-like inventory if expiry holds above 7675
monetization_zones.description: Repeated buy-lower/sell-higher put spreads express limited downside with risk acceptance above the short 7675 leg.

summary.headline: Friday remains defensive through 7640/7580 put demand, while raw call selling is distorted by deep-ITM complex flow

leave_one_out.comment: Removing the deep-ITM 7025C cluster flips Friday call premium from strongly net sold to net bought; bearish interpretation should rely on near-spot puts and structures instead.

levels.label: FRI 7640-7645 PROTECTION / BUTTERFLY CENTER
levels.interpretation: A 541-lot 7640P buy and a 7605/7645/7680 put butterfly-like package make this the closest material Friday downside zone.

levels.label: FRI 7580 TAIL HEDGE
levels.interpretation: 7580 carries the dominant premium within a broader 7510-7580 block put-buying ladder.

levels.label: FRI 7700-7725 CALL SUPPLY
levels.interpretation: Fresh 175x call sales at both 7700 and 7725 maintain late-week upper friction.

levels.label: FRI NEAR-SPOT DEFENSIVE PACKAGE
levels.interpretation: Matched 7650/7660 put buying and 7685 call selling is a direct near-spot defensive package.

structures.interpretation: Large 541-contract 7640P purchase makes 7640 an active downside-protection level. The spread flag prevents treating it as a proven standalone opening hedge.
Large block put buying from 7580 down to 7510 reinforces a lower-tail protection ladder; 7580 is the dominant premium concentration.
Equal-size sale of 7700C and 7725C adds late-week upside supply, but does not by itself prove a naked overwrite.
36x long 7605P, 72x short 7645P, 36x long 7680P forms a 1:-2:1 put butterfly-like package with maximum-value geometry around 7645.
Matched 35/40-lot buys of 7650P and 7660P with sales of 7685C create a defensive collar/risk-reversal-like package around the current market.
Deep-ITM call-sale cluster carries mostly intrinsic value and dominates raw call premium. It is excluded from directional interpretation via structure-level leave-one-out.
